chain_words.nuance: above average size, a neutral and slightly formal word
extremely big, almost unbelievable in size

explanation: These words all describe great size, from fairly large to extremely big. A huge pile of laundry after cleaning the house is a good everyday example.

usage_notes.difference: 'Big' is the most common everyday word; 'large' sounds more formal and is often used on signs, in shops or in reports.
